description: Advanced line-based file editor. Supports multiple non-contiguous edits in a single call and protects against stale writes using content hashes.

edits.description: List of edits to apply sequentially.

expectedHash.description: The expected SHA-256 hash of the file content before applying edits. If it doesn't match, the edit will fail.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to edit.

name: ag_edit
